SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_COPY_KITTY.descrip: Play a copy of a random card another player played this turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_GAMBLING_ADDICTION:
[gold]Gamble[/gold] {Gamble:diff()}.
The next time you draw an [gold]Erratic[/gold] card, gain [gold]Intangible[/gold] equal to its randomized energy cost.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_BLOOD_BATH.title: Blood Bath
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_JOLTING_PAIN.title: Jolting Pain
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_JOLTING_PAIN.descr: ALL [gold]Wounds[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold] lose [gold]Unplayable[/gold] and are enchanted with [gold]Adroit {Adroit}[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_HEMATOMA.title: Hematoma
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_HEMATOMA.descripti:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Discard your [gold]Wounds[/gold] and draw as many cards.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_FUNNY_DANCE.title: Funny Dance
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_FUNNY_DANCE.descri:
Gain X [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] X times.
Next turn, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] X times.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_BLOOD_DROP.title: Blood Drop
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_WINK.title: Wink
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_BYPASS.title: Bypass
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_BYPASS.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Add a {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Slash+[/gold]|[gold]Slash[/gold]} into your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_IMPROVISED_ACUPUNC:
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
Draw as many cards{IfUpgraded:show: +1|}.
Increase this card's HP loss by [blue]1[/blue] this combat.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_BURNING_PAIN.title: Burning Pain
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_BURNING_PAIN.descr: ALL [gold]Wounds[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold] lose [gold]Unplayable[/gold] and are enchanted with [gold]Sown[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_LURE.title: Lure
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_NEVER_LEARN.title: Never Learn
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_NEVER_LEARN.descri: If you have more [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] than HP, gain {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_BLOOD_MIXING.title: Blood Mixing
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_TORNADO_STANCE.des:
Add [gold]Replay[/gold] to ALL your [gold]Slashes[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] them|}.
Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] for each of your [gold]Slashes[/gold].{InCombat:
(Gain {VulnerableAmount:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold])|}
Doesn't include the [gold]Exhausted[/gold] ones.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_DO_THIS_ALL_DAY.de: Put ALL [gold]Slashes[/gold] from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] into your {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Draw Pile[/gold]|[gold]Discard Pile[/gold]}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_GO_CRAZY.title: Go Crazy
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_THREATENING_PROMIS:
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Add a [gold]Perfect Fit[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Slash+[/gold]|[gold]Slash[/gold]} into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] for each [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] on the enemy.
Repeat if you are [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].{InCombat:{HasTarget:cond:>0?
([gold]Slashes[/gold] added: {SlashesAmount:diff()})|}|}
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_HUMILIATE.title: Humiliate
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_SPECTACULAR_BREAK_:
[gold]Blood Bend[/gold] X.
Add {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} [gold]Glass 2[/gold] [gold]Slashes[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_SUMMON_WRATH.title: Summon Wrath
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_SUMMON_WRATH.descr:
Lose {IfUpgraded:show:[blue]1[/blue]|X} HP.
Put X random [gold]Slashes[/gold] from your [gold]Draw[/gold] or [gold]Discard Piles[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] them.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_PIN_THEM_DOWN.desc:
[gold]Blood Bend[/gold] X.
Add {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} [gold]Inky[/gold] [gold]Slashes[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_HOLD_BREATH.title: Hold Breath
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_HOLD_BREATH.descri:
Add [gold]Erratic[/gold] to ALL cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Shuffle ALL your cards into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_EXCITED_WAIT.title: Excited Wait
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_EXCITED_WAIT.descr:
[gold]Gamble[/gold] {Gamble:diff()}.
The next time you draw an [gold]Erratic[/gold] card, gain energy equal to its randomized energy cost.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_U_TURN.title: U-Turn
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_U_TURN.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Discard ALL cards drawn this way that do not cost [blue]0[/blue].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_COOL_BANDAGES.desc: The next {CoolBandages:diff()} [gold]Wounds[/gold] are free to play and make ALL enemies lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP when played.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_EYE_OPENING_REALIZ: ALL [gold]Wounds[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold] lose [gold]Unplayable[/gold] and are enchanted with [gold]Swift {Swift}[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_CONCEDE_FIRST_BLOW:
Gain {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Next turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} additional cards.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_OPEN_WOUNDS.title: Open Wounds
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_OPEN_WOUNDS.descri:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
The next {OpenWounds:diff()} times you lose HP, add a [gold]Wound[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_PRESS_THE_ATTACK.d:
Add a [gold]Momentum 5[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Slash+[/gold]|[gold]Slash[/gold]} into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
It loses [gold]Exhaust[/gold] and gains [gold]Erratic[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_RUNNING_JOKE.title: Running Joke
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_RUNNING_JOKE.descr:
Draw cards until you draw a non-Attack card.
Apply [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] equal to the number of cards drawn this way.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_RECALL_BLOOD.title: Recall Blood
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_RECALL_BLOOD.descr: Whenever you [gold]Blood Bend[/gold] X, ALL enemies lose X HP, and you gain X [gold]Vigor[/gold] next turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_BEAST_FORM.title: Beast Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_BEAST_FORM.descrip: At the start of your turn, if you have more [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] than [gold]Strength[/gold], gain {BeastForm:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_BRUTAL_TEACHINGS.d: Whenever you lose HP, gain {BrutalTeachings:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] until the end of your turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_DARK_POWERS.title: Dark Powers
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_DARK_POWERS.descri: The first time you play a [gold]Slash[/gold] each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to a random enemy.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_DICE_BLESSING.desc: At the start of your turn, draw {DiceBlessing:diff()} additional card and [gold]Gamble[/gold] {DiceBlessing:diff()}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_SAVAGERY.title: Savagery
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_SAVAGERY.descripti: You deal [blue]10%[/blue] more damage to [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] enemies for each of your first {Savagery:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_COMBO_METER.title: Combo Meter
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_COMBO_METER.descri: Add a copy of the first [gold]Slash[/gold] you play each turn into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_WEIRD_FLEX.title: Weird Flex
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_WEIRD_FLEX.descrip: Whenever you draw a [gold]Wound[/gold], gain {WeirdFlex:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] until the end of your turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_LAUGH_IT_OFF.title: Laugh It Off
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_BLEED_INSTRUCTIONS: If you lose HP at least once during your turn, draw {BleedInstructions:diff()} additional {BleedInstructions:plural:card|cards} at the start of your next turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_SPLASH_ARMOR.title: Splash Armor
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_SPLASH_ARMOR.descr: Whenever you [gold]Blood Bend[/gold] X, ALL players gain X [gold]Block[/gold], and [gold]Block[/gold] is not removed at the start of their next {IfUpgraded:show:{SplashArmor} turns|turn}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_SHOW_OFF.title: Show Off
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_SHOW_OFF.descripti: Whenever a [gold]Wound[/gold] is put into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold], gain {ShowOff:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_LIVE_WITH_THE_PAIN: At the start of your turn, lose [blue]2[/blue] HP and gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the number of your {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Wounds[/gold], including the [gold]Exhausted[/gold] ones|non-[gold]Exhausted[/gold] [gold]Wounds[/gold]}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_GAMBLERS_LUCK.desc:
Whenever you draw a card during your turn, gain its energy cost as [gold]Block[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_UNTELEGRAPH_ATTACK:
Add {Cards:diff()} {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Slashes+[/gold]|[gold]Slashes[/gold]} into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
[gold]Gamble[/gold] {Gamble:diff()}.
ALL [gold]Slashes[/gold] now hit a number of times equal to their energy cost +{UntelegraphAttacks:diff()}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_BIG_NUMBERS.title: Big Numbers
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_BIG_NUMBERS.descri:
[gold]Gamble[/gold] {Gamble:diff()}.
Increase the maximum energy cost an [gold]Erratic[/gold] card can have by {BigNumbers:diff()}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_JOKE_AND_RUN.title: Joke and Run
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_JOKE_AND_RUN.descr:
Gain {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Gain {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
Heal HP equal to your [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].{InCombat:
(Heal {HealAmount:diff()} HP)|}
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SEELS_AGGRAVATING_DEMEAN:
Whenever you gain [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], gain [gold]Block[/gold] next turn equal to your [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], up to {AggravatingDemeanor:diff()}.
Gain {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_ANVIL_STRIKE.title: Anvil Strike
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_ANVIL_STRIKE.descri:
Gain {Random:diff()} [gold]Random[/gold].
Deal damage equal to the number of times you gained [gold]Random[/gold] this combat.{InCombat:
(Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
Apply [gold]Weak[/gold] equal to your [gold]Random[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CREATIVE_BREAK.sele: Choose a card to gain Retain.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_ENTHUSIASTIC_WAVE.d: Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Steady[/gold] [gold]{Cards:plural:Fresh Idea|Fresh Ideas}[/gold] into {IfUpgraded:show:ALL players' [gold]Hands[/gold]|another player's [gold]Hand[/gold]}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_TRASH_DISPOSAL.desc:
Add a [gold]Throw Garbage[/gold] into {IfUpgraded:show:ALL players' [gold]Hands[/gold]|another player's [gold]Hand[/gold]}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_THROW_GARBAGE.title: Throw Garbage
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_THROW_GARBAGE.descr:
Put any number of cards from your [gold]Hand[/gold] into {InCombat:[gold]{OriginalPlayer}[/gold]'s|the sender's} [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_RANDOM_PORTAL.title: Random Portal
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_RANDOM_PORTAL.descr: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] 1 card. Another player adds a{IfUpgraded:show:n upgraded|} copy of it and a [gold]Return Portal{IfUpgraded:show:+|}[/gold] into their [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_RETURN_PORTAL.title: Return Portal
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_RETURN_PORTAL.descr: Put 1 card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] into {InCombat:[gold]{OriginalPlayer}[/gold]'s|the sender's} [gold]Hand[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.|}
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_RETURN_PORTAL.selec: Choose a card to send back.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_INSTANT_MATTRESS.de:
Gain {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
Until your next turn, whenever another player would take Attack damage from an enemy, you take it instead.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BICYCLE_TIME.title: Bicycle Time
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_RANDOM_BLAST.title: Random Blast
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_RANDOM_BLAST.descri: Whenever ANYONE plays a card this turn, apply {Confusion:diff()} [gold]Confusion[/gold] to a random enemy and increase this value by {Increase:diff()}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PAL_ARMOR.title: Pal Armor
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PAL_ARMOR.descripti:
Another player chooses a [gold]Form[/gold] Power out of one random [gold]Form[/gold] from each player's character.
It is free to play this turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BRAINSTORMING.title: Brainstorming
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BRAINSTORMING.descr: Whenever you play a [gold]Novel[/gold] card, ALL other players gain {Brainstorming:diff()} [gold]Random[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_HUMAN_FORM.title: Human Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_HUMAN_FORM.descript: At the end of your turn, gain [gold]Random[/gold] equal to the number of different cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Apply {Confusion:diff()} [gold]Confusion[/gold].
If you are [gold]Weak[/gold], apply it again.
If the enemy is [gold]Weak[/gold], apply it again.{InCombat:{HasTarget:cond:>0?
(Apply {ConfusionAmount:diff()} [gold]Confusion[/gold])|}|}
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPECIAL_STAGE.title: Emerald Challenge
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPECIAL_STAGE.descriptio:
Your next [gold]Elite[/gold] fight is harder: {Challenge}
When it starts, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] this. Win it to obtain the [gold]{Emerald}[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPECIAL_STAGE.challenge_: enemies can't take more than [blue]12[/blue] damage from a single card.
at the end of your turn, lose HP equal to the turn number.
whenever you play a card, lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold] until next turn.
the first card you play each turn costs [blue]1[/blue] more [gold]Energy[/gold].
at the end of your turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
all enemies start the fight with [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Ritual[/gold].
at the end of your turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a random card in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
it gains the challenge of your character's Emerald.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EMERALD_DOUBLE_DOWN.desc:
Apply the last debuff the enemy received again, as much as its [gold]Weak[/gold].{InCombat:{HasTarget:cond:>0?
(Apply {DoubleDownAmount:diff()})|}|}
